description: Unit tests for the NavMenu component in a Blazor application, verifying toggle behavior, authorized links, and unauthorized link visibility.

classes.name: NavMenuTests
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for the NavMenu component in a Blazor application.

methods.name: NavMenu_Toggle_Collapse_Class_Changes_On_Click
methods.description: Verifies that clicking the toggle button collapses or expands the NavMenu, checking for the presence or absence of the 'collapse' class.

methods.name: NavMenu_Authorized_Shows_UserLinks_And_Active_Link_On_Admin
methods.description: Checks that authorized users see user links, and the admin link becomes active based on navigation.

methods.name: NavMenu_Unauthorized_DoesNot_Show_Protected_Links
methods.description: Ensures that unauthorized users do not see protected links like 'manage/my-account' and 'Logout'.
